g.text: TYPICAL CRUDE PREHEAT EXCHANGER - TEMA AES (E-106)
1. Dimensions in mm; elevations in m (grade EL 100.000).
2. Typical for AES crude preheat shells E-101..E-111; E-106 shown (2 shells in series, stacked).
3. Crude shell side (square pitch, removable bundle); hot stream tube side.
4. Bundle-pull area = tube length + 1.5 m clear at channel end.
5. Lower shell saddle fixed, upper shells sliding; intermediate supports bolted.
ANCHOR BOLTS 4 x M24 PER SADDLE (SLOTTED AT SLIDING SADDLE)
1055 x 25.4 OD 12 BWG (2.77 mm), 6096 mm, 4 passes
